terms.title: Please Note Before Using Community Modules
terms.body:
The post-process modules provided by the community are third-party contributions and are not affiliated with this project's official team.

By installing and running community modules, you agree to bear the associated risks:

• The official team makes no guarantees about the security, stability, or completeness of community modules.
• Community modules run locally on your server and process your recording files; please ensure the source is trustworthy.
• It is recommended to review the module source repository to understand its behavior before installation.

If you understand and accept the above risks, you may proceed to use the module community.
